plan.scope: bounded synthetic backend mechanics; no embedding model or semantic-quality claim
plan.data_generator: sha256 deterministic coordinates; four clustered centers plus uniform points; lane is row index modulo 3; unique numeric vectors
plan.memory_method: isolated subprocess per backend/size/dimension; resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss converted to bytes; includes native allocations and baseline runtime; no tracemalloc
plan.timing_method: perf_counter; import/open, materialization, ingest, each cold filtered-tree build and warmed query p50/p95 measured separately; worker count 1
plan.decision_rule: Report all cells, misses, ties, timeouts and failures. No performance pass threshold or default winner. ANN recall below 0.95 triggers ITERATE, never query/budget/epsilon tuning. Real-corpus quality remains gated by #158.

scope: bounded synthetic backend mechanics; no embedding model or semantic-quality claim
limitations: bounded synthetic observations; no semantic quality or production-scale guarantee
cKDTree can degrade above about 20 dimensions; epsilon is an L2 distance approximation bound, not a recall guarantee
full API timing includes different verification/caching policies, not just nearest-neighbor kernels
cold queries include filtered-tree construction; all cold costs and native peaks are reported
RSS includes runtime, inputs, native dependencies and lifecycle validation; peak-minus-baseline is descriptive, not isolated allocation accounting
local timings are unpinned observational measurements; no speed winner or threshold is inferred
